Exercise: Alternating Kettlebell Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_press

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- muscle_hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:

- condition: shoulder instability, reason: May exacerbate existing shoulder issues.
- condition: recent shoulder surgery, reason: Should be avoided until fully healed.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Press, description: Perform the press with one arm at a time.
- name: Kettlebell Overhead Squat Press, description: Combine the press with an overhead squat for increased difficulty.

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Alternating Dumbbell Press, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you pull the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
- Press one directly overhead by extending through the elbow, turning it so the palm faces forward while holding the other kettlebell stationary .
- Lower the pressed kettlebell to the starting position and immediately press with your other arm.
